title: parley history transform
description: The opening line of a projected copy of a run on the shared history stream: every line of this run that follows on this stream is a projection of the receipt copy by the named transform, so a reader can tell a projected copy from a whole one and by what (spec §8, informative). Stream only: the receipt copy is never projected and never carries this line.

seq.description: The run's single counter (spec §1.3). This line takes a seq of its own and reaches no other sink, so the receipt copy has no line at this seq.

run.description: The execution whose copy on this stream is a projection (spec §2.1).

name.description: What the transform is called: the name its configuration gave it, or the function's own name.

sha256.description: SHA-256, hex, of the transform's source text as the runtime renders it. It tells two projections apart and pins which one wrote this copy; it is not a build identity, and nothing fetches it.

version.description: Full validation is against the schema for this exact id and version (spec §4.5, §4.6).
